rate_limits: 15 requests/second per IP (global rate limit); 5500 requests/hour recommended maximum; bulk/download use discouraged via REST—use FTP or Perl/Python APIs for large jobs.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: ORIGINAL CONFIRMED. Official Rate Limits wiki (github.com/Ensembl/ensembl-rest/wiki/Rate-Limits) documents 15 req/s per IP global limit and ~5500 req/hour as the recommended max; bulk work should use FTP or client APIs, not REST. Verifier B marked incorrect but proposed an identical string—no material change. Automated curl HTTP 0 is a bot/network false positive; Ensembl REST remains operational at rest.ensembl.org.
